title: Team AI training for schools and tutoring businesses
meta_description: A one-day, hands-on AI workshop for teachers, tutors, and office staff, run on the school's own tools and documents. $1,000 per person, 5-person minimum.
h1: Team AI training for schools and tutoring businesses
intro: In many cases teachers, tutors, and office staff at a school or tutoring center already have an AI tool available, either Gemini inside Google Workspace or Copilot inside Microsoft 365. Their daily writing is well suited to it: lesson plans, session notes, progress reports, parent emails, program descriptions, and enrollment correspondence. What is usually missing is a working method each person can apply to their own documents, and agreement across the team on what is appropriate to use it for.

Creosote Labs runs a one-day workshop, on site or remote, in the AI tool the organization already uses. Participants bring their own computers and their own documents and produce real work during the session: a progress report drafted from real session notes, a term newsletter, a reply to a common parent inquiry. Each person documents their own process, the team receives a written guide, and a 30-day follow-up session is included.
projects: A workshop for a tutoring center's staff on drafting progress reports from session notes in the center's template.
A session for a school's front office on handling enrollment inquiries and parent correspondence with Gemini or Copilot.
A teacher-focused day on preparing lesson plans, differentiated practice sets, and rubrics from the school's own curriculum documents.
A workshop for an administrator and office team on summarizing attendance and billing data for the owner or board.
A program with three monthly follow-up sessions for a growing tutoring company adding new tutors each term.

faqs.q: How much does team AI training cost?
faqs.a: $1,000 per person for up to 10 people, with a 5-person minimum. Larger teams are quoted, travel is included, and a program with three monthly follow-up sessions is $1,400 per person.

faqs.q: Do teachers and tutors need any AI experience beforehand?
faqs.a: No. The day starts from the tool the school already has and each participant works on their own computer with their own documents, so prior experience is not required.
A laptop with access to the organization's AI tool and a few real documents from their own work, such as a lesson plan, recent session notes, or a parent email they need to write.
